regional_context: Eastern tropical South Atlantic, northern Angola Basin, immediately north of the commonly mapped Congo deep-sea fan extent; published Congo Fan summaries commonly span roughly 3E-10E and 4S-10.5S.

data_sources.GEBCO_2026: global 15 arc-second bathymetry plus Type Identifier grid; exact cell available but source class must be checked
data_sources.GMRT: global multi-resolution topography with point service, cruise tracks and curated multibeam swath polygons
data_sources.GUINESS_ZAIANGO_ZAISAR_ZAICAR: regional multibeam/sonar/sub-bottom/seismic coverage across large parts of Congo fan system
data_sources.WACS_CONGOLOBE: selected high-resolution ROV multibeam and seabed observations on terminal lobes

lidar_boundary: Deep-ocean target is not realistically a bathymetric-lidar problem; sonar/multibeam and marine geophysics are the primary data classes.
